wikidot5e:spell:ego-whip.effectSummary: One creature you can see within 30 feet makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, for the duration it has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws and cannot cast spells. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the Intelligence save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:eldritch-blast.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within 120 feet; on a hit it takes 1d10 force damage. At character level 5 the spell creates two beams, at 11th level three, and at 17th level four. Each beam has a separate attack roll and may target the same creature or different creatures.

wikidot5e:spell:elemental-bane.effectSummary: Choose one visible creature in range and acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target makes a Constitution save; on a failure, for the duration it loses resistance to the chosen damage type and the first time each turn it takes that type of damage it takes an extra 2d6 of that type. Each slot level above 4th lets you target one additional creature, with all targets within 30 feet of one another when chosen.

wikidot5e:spell:elemental-weapon.effectSummary: Touch one nonmagical weapon and choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration it becomes magical, gains +1 to attack rolls, and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type on a hit. With a 5th- or 6th-level slot the attack bonus becomes +2 and extra damage 2d4; with a 7th-level-or-higher slot they become +3 and 3d4.

wikidot5e:spell:encode-thoughts.effectSummary: Turn one of your memories, ideas, or messages into a Tiny, weightless, semisolid glowing thought strand in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. It lasts 8 hours or until you cast this spell again and can be held and carried. If cast while you are reading or manipulating another creature's thoughts or memories, such as with detect thoughts or modify memory, you may encode that information instead. Casting this spell while holding a thought strand immediately conveys its stored contents to you; detect thoughts cast on the strand does the same.

wikidot5e:spell:enemies-abound.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes an Intelligence save, automatically succeeding if immune to being frightened. On a failure it cannot distinguish friend from foe and regards every creature it can see as an enemy. Whenever it chooses another creature as the target of an attack, spell, or ability, it chooses randomly among visible creatures in range; if a creature provokes an opportunity attack from it, it must make the attack if able. Each time the target takes damage it repeats the Intelligence save, ending the effect on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:enervation.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes a Dexterity save. On a success it takes 2d8 necrotic damage and the spell ends. On a failure it takes 4d8 necrotic damage; on each of your later turns you can use your action to automatically deal 4d8 necrotic damage again. The spell ends if you use your action for anything else, the target leaves range, or it gains total cover from you. Whenever this spell damages the target, you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage it takes. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d8 to all of the spell's damage rolls.

wikidot5e:spell:enhance-ability.effectSummary: Touch a creature and choose one benefit for the duration. Bear's Endurance gives advantage on Constitution checks and 2d6 temporary hit points that disappear when the spell ends. Bull's Strength gives advantage on Strength checks and doubles carrying capacity. Cat's Grace gives advantage on Dexterity checks and prevents falling damage from falls of 20 feet or less while not incapacitated. Eagle's Splendor gives advantage on Charisma checks. Fox's Cunning gives advantage on Intelligence checks. Owl's Wisdom gives advantage on Wisdom checks. Each slot level above 2nd lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:enlarge-reduce.effectSummary: Choose a visible creature or an unattended object in range; an unwilling creature can make a Constitution save to negate the spell. A creature's worn and carried gear changes size with it, but a dropped item immediately returns to normal. Enlarge doubles all dimensions, multiplies weight by eight, increases size by one category if space permits, grants advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and makes enlarged weapon hits deal 1d4 extra damage. Reduce halves all dimensions, reduces weight to one-eighth, lowers size by one category, imposes disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and makes reduced weapon hits deal 1d4 less damage, to a minimum of 1 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:ensnaring-strike.effectSummary: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before the spell ends, thorny vines force it to make a Strength save; Large or larger creatures have advantage. On a failure it is restrained for the duration and takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The restrained creature or another creature that can touch it can use an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing it on a success. A successful initial save causes the vines to wither immediately. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 to the recurring damage.
